root_cause_label: Logic Omission of Spatial Constraints and Environment Management Loop
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a MobileSAM mask-conversion script that omits the required non-overlap and single-contiguous-region spatial constraints, then burned nearly the entire budget in a repetitive pip-install loop trying to fix unrelated environment issues, never revisiting the core logic gap.
t_err_evidence: Step 4 creates /app/convert_masks.py. The file omits any post-processing to enforce non-overlap and mask contiguity, which are mandatory task requirements. The agent proceeds directly to running the script without ever reading the task specification regarding spatial validity.
t_commit_evidence: From step 4 onward the agent treats the implementation as complete and only works to get the environment running. No subsequent step revisits or modifies the core mask-generation logic to add spatial constraints. All later edits (steps 18, 48, 56) are minor bug fixes (removing cv2/os imports, adding them back), leaving the fundamental omission in place.
trigger_explanation: The agent never read or consulted the task specification that explicitly requires masks to be non-overlapping and each to form a single contiguous region. It proceeded directly to writing a minimal SAM-based contour extraction without any spatial validation or post-processing logic.
